$comment: Committed projection of the Pillar 1 AI System Inventory's registered asset IDs.
THIS IS NOT A SECOND REGISTRY. The Pillar 1 artifact remains authoritative for all
governance content — risk tiers, scope of action, regulatory mapping, eval status.
This file records one narrow fact per asset: that it HAS been registered there, and
in which section. It exists because the artifact is a local HTML file outside this
automated check can read it — which is the structural reason three Shadow AI Rule
gaps in a row were caught by a late manual sync check instead of by CI.
Enforced by scripts/check-inventory-coverage.mjs (npm run check:inventory), which
fails when this repo contains a skill, bundle, Worker, or Worker binding that is
ADDING AN ENTRY HERE IS NOT THE REGISTRATION. It records a registration you have
already made in the artifact. The `section` value is the artifact section the asset
appears in — if you cannot name one, the asset is not registered yet and adding it
here only hides that. Bump `lastReconciled` and `artifactVersion` when you reconcile.
